blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A policeman who went absent without leave, previously flagged for illegal drug use, was arrested along with a civilian in a buy-bust operation here yesterday afternoon. In an emailed advisory, the Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) said the police corporal, categorized as a high-value target, was apprehended at 3:19 p.m. on October 22, inside an NHA housing site in Barangay Kauswagan. Anti-narcotics operatives seized 0.64 grams of suspected shabu (crystal meth) valued at P4,352. Brig. Gen. Nestor Babagay Jr., PRO-10 director, said the corporal’s arrest underscores the regional command’s aggressive internal cleansing and integrity monitoring efforts. READ: […]...
